evidence.reason: Admission now persists the failed receipt verification as receipt_unavailable on the item (clearing it when a receipt later verifies on reuse or is republished on completion), and status() — which backs status ops, retry() for identical submissions, cancel, and notify-update — reports next_action="resubmit" with reason="receipt-unavailable" so the recovery cue survives subsequent status and retry responses; local tests were not run because the harness permits only git/read commands, so CI remains the authority.
